objective: Best-for-best comparison of printed Quiroga adaFGD and stochastic FRAMES on the Quiroga-style global-probe/2d-outcome-POVM sensing design, with independently calibrated method-native TP penalties and shared physical evaluation conditions.

acceptance_before_transfer: retain the completed focused/full validation and independent audit record
obtain explicit authorization for transfer and submission
stage the exact committed tree and verify its revision on Ruche before any smoke submission
source.setup_note: The repository was not modified while finalizing this bundle. Remote transfer and submission remain separate, unauthorized actions.

preservation.prior_corrected_campaign_role: exploratory or ablation evidence only; it was not selected and frozen under this best-for-best protocol
preservation.legacy_high_qubit_role: retain as local-Pauli/QPT_BFW sensing evidence, not as Quiroga-style sensing evidence
preservation.superseded_common_penalty_role: The old shared-penalty bundle is preserved unchanged, but is superseded for primary claims and may be used only as a matched-penalty ablation.

scientific_contract.sensing: Quiroga-style d^2 global probes with one generalized 2d-outcome POVM

printed_adafgd.applied_penalty: lambda_Q=m*alpha_Q, fixed for the complete trajectory

frames.penalty_direction: alpha_F,k strictly increases and beta_k decreases with zero-based update k
frames.alpha_grid_independence_note: This is a separate FRAMES candidate grid. Equal numeric entries do not pair, constrain, or share alpha with printed adaFGD.

scientific_contract.objective_comparison_rule: Penalized objectives are method-native diagnostics. They are never subtracted, differenced, pooled, or used as a cross-method selection or ranking score.
scientific_contract.budget_caveat: Equal logical row epochs do not imply equal computation. Record wall time, FRAMES LMO/oracle work, and printed adaFGD spectral-norm work separately.

candidate_identity.note: Config IDs identify method-native candidates; there is no shared-alpha config ID.

calibration: Evaluate every predeclared candidate at the same regime-specific calibration row budget and checkpoints.
Treat every numerical exception or incomplete trajectory as a gate failure and preserve it.

Rank candidates separately within each method: highest nested recovery-gate pass rate; then highest mean number of gate components passed; then highest median fidelity; then lowest median full-design RMSE; then lowest median normalized TP violation; then lexicographically smallest canonical config ID.
Do not use either method-native penalized objective in selection or cross-method differences.
Write one immutable selection manifest per regime containing the source commit, grid and rule IDs, data/row/U0 hashes, all candidate outcomes, and the selected printed and FRAMES config IDs.
validation: Run only the two already selected configurations on validation instances.
Require the selection-manifest SHA-256 and both selected config IDs in every record.
Validation is confirmatory and cannot rerank candidates; a protocol change requires a new campaign and new IDs.
heldout: Freeze source commit, complete method configurations, selection manifest, data regime, row budget, checkpoints, gate, and analysis before exposing held-out outcomes.
Require identical selection-manifest SHA-256 and config IDs across every record in one cohort.
Never reuse exposed seeds 1-3 as unseen held-out instances.
selection_protocol.aggregation: FRAMES sampling streams are nested within initializations, which are nested within independent channel/data instances. Deterministic printed adaFGD is counted once per paired initialization.

regimes_in_order.gate_rmse_source: all 128 full-design rows, not only the 96 training rows

regimes_in_order.start_condition: Run only after both n=2 regimes pass launcher, archive, accounting, selection-manifest, and aggregation checks.

phases.name: post_test_local_smoke
phases.scientific_role: launcher and provenance plumbing only; two row epochs are not a recovery experiment

pre_submission_requirements: obtain explicit authorization for transfer and submission
create the unique remote output root before sbatch so Slurm can open its log
verify the exact clean commit and staged source on Ruche
inspect the user-scoped queue for duplicate campaign jobs

not_yet_created: scientific calibration, validation, or held-out results
